manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball passing through zero velocity at the top with a second ball released from rest at that same instant.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball climbing and falling beside a second ball released by a gate at the top height. Blue velocity vectors flip sign through zero while dashed acceleration vectors point continuously down.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
